text:
alice.ops: Heads-up — scheduled GPU node drain in us-west1 for kernel patching. Window: 2024-05-12 02:00–05:00 UTC. Targeting a staggered drain of ~12% of serving capacity, will run graceful eviction. Posting statuspage + customer notice drafts below.

ben.oncall: Ack. I’ll own pager for the window. Plan: canary drain 2 nodes first, watch lat/5xx for 30m, then continue.

carol.sre: Quick q — embeddings and streaming workloads impacted differently? Any expectations re tail latency?

alice.ops: embeddings will see slightly higher token p95 on routed hosts, streaming might get small connector delays while clients reconnect to alternate hosts. Estimate <5% spike in 5xx for ~10–20m per canary.

ben.oncall: Good. I’ll enable spillover routing to dedicated pool during drain window to reduce user-visible errors.

alice.ops: Pushing statuspage draft to staging: https://staging.status.redwood.example/incident/174450. Text below for review.

sre-bot: DRAFT STATUSPAGE ENTRY:
- Component: API (us-west1)
- Status: Degraded performance (planned maintenance)
- Start: 2024-05-12 02:00 UTC
- ETA: 2024-05-12 05:00 UTC
- Notes: Rolling maintenance on a subset of GPU hosts. We may route traffic to alternate capacity; some requests may experience higher latencies or short errors.

alice.ops: Customer-facing email copy (short):
"Hello — we will be performing planned maintenance in our US‑West region on 12 May 2024 from 02:00–05:00 UTC. During this window a subset of inference hosts will be drained to apply security patches. Your traffic will continue to be served; you may see brief increases in latency or retries. No data will be deleted. If you run into any issues please reply to this message or contact support."

carol.sre: LGTM with one tweak — call out recommended retry policy (exponential backoff up to 3 retries). I can add a one-liner. :thumbsup:

alice.ops: Added. Finalizing customer copy and will schedule outbound at 01:00 UTC for a 1-hour advance notice.

ben.oncall: Runbook snippet for graceful eviction posted:```
# drain node gracefully
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=30m
# monitor in-flight requests via /metrics, watch token p95 and 5xx
```

dana.support: Will prepare a support playbook and canned replies for inbound tickets referencing the statuspage. Sharing templates in #support later today.

ben.oncall: During window I’ll post periodic updates every 30m to the statuspage and here in thread. If any customer impact exceeds 5% sustained 5xx or >2x p95, escalate to ENG-SRE and move to on-call bridge.

alice.ops: Noted. Handoff plan: ben takes pager at 01:30 UTC; I’ll remain on standby until completion. After completion we’ll post a completion notice and update RCA placeholder if anything unexpected happens.

carol.sre: One more ask — please ensure we set automatic fallback to last-known-good model variant for chat endpoints, to reduce quality regressions if routing flips.

alice.ops: Will add fallback policy to the rollout config.

sre-bot: REMINDER scheduled in 30m: Post 1-hour customer notice and attach support playbook.

ben.oncall: Thanks — team aligned. :white_check_mark:
